description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'ResourceOptimizedPlacementDirector' implementing placement logic for Orleans silos, including resource-based silo selection algorithms using statistics and scoring mechanisms.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementDirector
classes.description: Implements resource-aware silo placement logic, scoring silos based on system statistics, and selecting optimal silos for activation placement.

classes.name: NormalizedWeights
classes.description: A record storing normalized weights for different resource metrics used in scoring.

classes.name: ResourceStatistics
classes.description: A record encapsulating resource usage and availability metrics for silos, with a static method to create instances from runtime statistics.

methods.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementDirector
methods.description: Constructor initializing placement director with local silo details, load publisher, and configuration options.

methods.name: NormalizeWeights
methods.description: Calculates normalized resource weights based on input options.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the appropriate silo for spawning a new activation based on resource scores and other constraints.

methods.name: RemoveSilo
methods.description: Removes a silo's statistics from management.

methods.name: SiloStatisticsChangeNotification
methods.description: Updates the stored statistics for a specific silo when they change.

methods.name: CalculateScore
methods.description: Computes a normalized score for a silo based on current resource metrics and configured weights.
